clusters.headline: MPR Convenes To Organize Selection For New Indonesian Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR has commenced joint meetings to establish protocols and timelines for selecting a new vice president.
Parliamentary factions are forming verification and ad-hoc teams to oversee the upcoming vacancy proceedings.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Political Parties Discuss Potential New Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto must submit two vice presidential candidates to the MPR within 14 days.
The MPR is currently organizing a joint meeting to determine the schedule for the official selection process.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Prepares For Upcoming Guns N' Roses And BTS Performances
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta provincial government is supporting the logistics, security, and comfort for upcoming Guns N' Roses and BTS concerts at Gelora Bung Karno Stadium.
Governor Pramono Anung announced extended operating hours for public transportation, including MRT and Transjakarta, to accommodate event attendees.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Formally Resigns As Indonesian Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially resigned from his position as the Vice President of Indonesia.
The resignation letter was submitted to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) following a period of intense political activity.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Address Fuel Subsidy Costs And Market Prices
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials confirm that fuel subsidy allocations remain secure for the remainder of 2026 despite rising global oil prices.
Finance Ministry representatives stated that market prices for Pertalite and Solar fuels significantly exceed the current subsidized consumer rates.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Authorities Detail Probe Into Illegal Wiretapping Case
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials are investigating an illegal wiretapping operation reportedly targeting President Prabowo Subianto.
A Brigadier General identified only as TK is currently undergoing questioning by the police internal affairs division.

clusters.headline: Pekanbaru Receives Multiple Regional Development Awards For 2026
aiSummaryBullets: Pekanbaru secured first place for economic growth acceleration in the 2026 regional government achievement awards.
The city was honored with the 2026 Nusantara Mover Award specifically for its commitment to infrastructure development.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Convenes Coalition Leaders At Bogor Palace
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto arrived at Bogor Palace to conduct meetings with leaders of the governing political coalition.
The discussions follow the official departure of Gibran Rakabuming Raka from the position of Vice President.

clusters.headline: Jensen Huang Resigns As NVIDIA CEO Following Personal Scandals
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has officially stepped down as the CEO and President of NVIDIA.
The resignation follows public reports regarding espionage allegations and an extramarital affair.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Reports State Budget Deficit Of Rp379 Trillion For October
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian government recorded a state budget deficit of Rp379.3 trillion by October 2026, representing 1.47 percent of the national GDP.
Customs and excise revenue reached Rp267.2 trillion for the year up to October, while total government spending hit Rp2,997 trillion.
